targets.problem: Design agent systems that remember, act, and recover.
targets.solution: Inflection's agentic stack needs context retrieval, reliable tool use, observability, and evaluation. My work connects those problems: identity-bound durable sessions, typed memory-to-policy decisions, and receipt-bound action orchestration.
targets.first_move: Walk through one end-to-end agent trace, identify the point where a timed-out tool response becomes ambiguous, and specify a replay-safe state transition plus a targeted evaluation that reproduces the failure.

targets.problem: Make AI work observable from intent to actual effects.
targets.solution: Origin builds endpoint AI observability. I have implemented the complementary agent-side mechanisms: correlate instructions to tool actions, preserve provider receipts, distinguish proposed from applied state, and recover after lost acknowledgments.
